sentences.text: Petitioner is ready to pay Rs.5,000/- (Rupees Five Thousand) per month to opposite party No.2 in the first week of every month as per the bank account details furnished by her in the learned Court below.

6. In view of the matter, let the above named petitioner be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/Successor Court in Complaint Case No. 1678 of 2016, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
7.

It is made clear that if the petitioner fails to pay the aforesaid amount on two consecutive months,
opposite party no.2 shall be at liberty to move before the learned Court below Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.34146 of 2023(4) dt.15-09-2023 for cancellation of the bail bond of the petitioner.
8.
It goes without saying that the aforesaid payment shall be subject to any order passed in matrimonial maintenance case or any other collateral proceedings.

9. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 is directed to make available the bank account details of opposite party no.2 within a period of two weeks by submitting affidavit of the same before the learned Court Below.

10. If so advised, either of the parties will be at liberty to make an application before the Court below for referring the matter to the District Mediation Centre for the purpose of reconciliation or one time settlement.
11. Accordingly, this application stands disposed of.

(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) anand/-
